press_releases.description: DOJ press releases (Office of Public Affairs and all 94 U.S. Attorney's Offices, FBI, DEA, ATF, ...): title, date, component, topic, teaser, HTML body, URL.

parameters[title].desc: title words: "fentanyl trafficking" in double quotes = phrase; without quotes = all words; case-insensitive

parameters[date].desc: one day: YYYY-MM-DD or a Unix timestamp (no ranges; use since/until)

since.desc: pack option, not sent: keep releases dated on or after YYYY-MM-DD (pages newest first and stops early)

until.desc: pack option, not sent: keep releases dated on or before YYYY-MM-DD

sort.desc: sort field (default order is not by date: set it)

press_release.description: One press release with its full HTML body.

blog_entries.description: DOJ blog entries (Justice Blog, about 3,300 since 2009). No title or date filter upstream; since/until filter locally.

since.desc: pack option, not sent: keep entries dated on or after YYYY-MM-DD

until.desc: pack option, not sent: keep entries dated on or before YYYY-MM-DD

blog_entry.description: One blog entry with its full body.
